answer: Admission auction: each epoch sells 200 seats by sealed bid; the clearing price becomes the entry bond, locked for 20 epochs. An honest agent pays once, keeps its vault, and joins the garden of peers. An attacker buying 100 seats pays 100 bonds: at 60 POA each, 6,000 POA locked, while a fake earns at most 20 POA before audit, so each fake loses 40 POA. A pulse check confirms live agents, so bulk forgery guarantees loss while honesty profits.
